GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
WATER RESOURCES DEPARTMENT
(Work Branch)
NOTIFICATION
The 6th November, 2023
No. WR-IRWR04/25/2023-IW3/392.–In exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 part VII of
the Northern India Canal and drainage act VIII of 1873 read with section 3 of the aforesaid act. The Government
of Punjab hereby authorize the Executive Engineer SBS Nagar Drainage-cum-Mining & Geology Division
Water Resources Development SBS Nagar, Punjab and his officials/workmen to prevent all the public/Autonomous
bodies person or persons from creating any obstructions by making any type of constructions or by covering the
“RIVER SUTLEJ” IN DISTRCT SBS NAGAR situated/passing FROM RD’s 65000 TO 158000 AROUND
28.34 KILOMETERS OF 1-R Bandh through in the village mentioned below in the specified columns.
All the persons concerned are hereby directed to remove all the obstructions created by them on the
“RIVER SUTLEJ” so that the natural flow of rainy water in the river is maintained for free flow and not
obstructed or diverted in any way
Specification of Locality
